actions.addCustomSources.description: Upload one or more files as custom sources for training
actions.addCustomSources.props.files.des: One or more files to upload (PDF, Word, Text, Markdown, HTML, Excel, CSV, PowerPoint, PNG, JPEG, GIF)
actions.askQuestions.description: Query your Chat Aid knowledge base and receive AI-generated answers with source citations
actions.askQuestions.props.messageTs.des: Optional Unix timestamp of current message. Use with parentTs for follow-up questions in a conversation.
actions.askQuestions.props.parentTs.desc: Optional Unix timestamp for conversation threading. Use the same value for related questions in a conversation.
actions.askQuestions.props.prompt.descri: The question to ask the knowledge base
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.getCustomSourceById.description: Retrieve single source details by ID
actions.getCustomSourceById.props.source: The ID of the custom source to retrieve
